summary: Verified mobile responsive fix for hero section overflow across viewports (390px, 360px) and languages (EN/DE/EL), plus desktop 1920px regression check. All measurements confirm no horizontal overflow: document.documentElement.scrollWidth == window.innerWidth, and h1/subtitle/jar right edges are within viewport bounds. Screenshots visually confirm the German 'echtes Geld.' and English 'real money.' and Greek subtitle text render fully without right-edge clipping. Crest scales down responsively (358px wide on 390px viewport, 328px on 360px viewport, retains 440px on desktop).
critical_code_review_comments: AnimatedJar.jsx now correctly uses w-full max-w-[440px] aspect-square — image scales fluidly without breaking layout.
App.js hero grid column has min-w-0 which correctly prevents flex/grid children from forcing container widths beyond viewport.
H1 uses responsive font sizing (text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl) with break-words — safe for long compound words in German.
Root div overflow-x-hidden is defensive but works. Consider adding overflow-x-hidden also on <html>/<body> globally in index.css as extra safety for iOS Safari.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile responsive hero fix verified working. Measured at 390 & 360 widths in EN/DE/EL: h1.right<=innerWidth, subtitle.right<=innerWidth, jar.right<=innerWidth, scrollWidth==innerWidth. Desktop 1920px unchanged (jar 440px).
